original: CAUTION: cancer cells that multiply really fast can grab glutamine too, to fuel their growth. So if you have an active colon or liver cancer, don't raise the dose that high. The liver is on that list because the blood from your gut goes straight there, through the portal vein, so a big dose of glutamine reaches your liver before anywhere else.
rewrite: CAUTION: cancer cells that multiply really fast can grab glutamine too, to fuel their growth, so if you have an active colon or liver cancer, don't go up to the 10-30g. With a dose that big, a lot of it passes through your gut cells into the portal vein, which runs straight to your liver, so a cancer there would get it first, while it's still concentrated.
